audit_kind: independent first audit of a new namespace (all 8 keys)

findings.finding: Feminine چاہتی vs masculine siblings (ui.browser.browser_consent_request.wants_to_open چاہتا). Grammatical with implied سائٹ; no change.
Button name اجازت دیں is unquoted; “اجازت دیں” would read clearer. Optional, no change.
System Settings › Privacy & Security kept in English, as the ur guide requires (macOS ships no Urdu UI). No manual bidi controls.

resolutions.before: کیمرے اور مائیکروفون کی درخواست برخاست کریں
resolutions.after: کیمرے اور مائیکروفون کی درخواست ہٹائیں
resolutions.reason: برخاست (dismissal of a person or court petition) is unidiomatic for closing a UI request and appears nowhere in the ur corpus; ur Dismiss controls use ہٹائیں (ui.agentMessages.banner.dismiss, update notice).

independence: Independent auditor (team lopdev task child, session d1da94af17b7); translator was agent coder. Same served model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5) — independence is by agent instance. No MT service, translation API or SDK used.
